name: Product Image Watermark for WooCommerce
author: WP Plugin Experts

sections.description:
Product Image Watermark for Woo plugin allows you to apply watermark on WooCommerce products images which should be a downloadable products. These watermarks can be an image copyright symbol, company logo or piece of branding text as a transparent PNG or Webp image.

Key Features:

✅ Fully Automated Protection: Watermarks are applied instantly to all new image uploads
✅ Bulk Processing: Secure your entire existing product catalog with one-click watermarking
✅ Customizable Watermarks:
– **Image/logo watermarks with transparency control
– **Flexible positioning (9 preset locations or custom coordinates)
✅ Seamless WooCommerce Integration: Works with product galleries, variations and thumbnails
✅ Lightweight Performance: No noticeable impact on your site speed
✅ Apply Watermark on any size of an image
✅ User friendly admin UI

Why This Plugin?

✅100% Free: No hidden costs or premium version – all features included
✅Developer Supported: Regularly updated and maintained by WPPluginExperts
✅Easy Setup: Configure in minutes with our intuitive settings panel

For detailed documentation and support, visit the official plugin site.
sections.installation:
Important: First of all, WooCommerce plugin must be activated on your wordpress website, without it Product Image Watermark for Woocommerce plugin will not work.

  1. Unzip the downloaded .zip file.
  2. Upload the Product Image Watermark for Woo plugin folder into the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress site.
  3. Activate Product Image Watermark for Woo from Plugins menu

Configuration

Product Image Watermark for Woo will add a new setting menu to the WooCommerce setting page with setting name “Download Image Watermark”. There you will be able to set the watermark image for each image sizes and set the position of watermark image.
sections.faq:
Why watermark not applied to some images? I have already regenerated thumbnails.

Please make sure you have attached image to any product from the admin menu Media -> Library
